{{Quote|There's a scrounger in Niima named Crusher Roodown. For years he was one of the Blobfish's best scavengers, but he got into a dispute with the Blobfish, and Unkar sent his thugs to cut off Crusher's arms.|Rey describes Roodown in her journal|<ref name="RSG">''[[Rey's Survival Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Roodown''', nicknamed "'''Crusher'''," was an [[Abednedo]] [[scavenger]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Jakku]]. Roodown angered his employer, the [[junk dealer]] [[Unkar Plutt]], who suspected the scavenger was selling salvage to a different buyer. As a consequence, Plutt's [[Unkar's thugs|thugs]] cut off Roodown's [[Limb|arms]], ending his career as a scavenger. However, Roodown was allowed to work for Plutt as a strong back around [[Niima Outpost]] using his replacement [[Labor droid|load-lifter]] arms, which greatly increased his strength.

Roodown once witnessed Plutt being kidnapped by the criminal [[Zool Zendiat]] and described what had happened to the scavenger [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] when she arrived to investigate. When a [[Sandstorm|desert storm]] later uncovered the downed [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Spectral]]'', Plutt encouraged the scavengers of Niima to ransack it for him and had Roodown throttle the scavenger [[Teedo (Niima Outpost)|Teedo]] when he questioned the junk dealer. [[Constable]] [[Zuvio]] then sliced off Roodown's mechanical hand in order to stop any further harm befalling Teedo. In [[34 ABY]], shortly after the [[First Order]] [[Attack on Tuanul|attacked]] the nearby [[Tuanul]] village, Roodown passed by Rey in the outpost.

==Biography==
===Punished by Plutt===
{{Quote|Crusher does odd jobs around Niima for half rations now, which is how I know the Blobfish regrets what he did—otherwise he would have had Crusher killed.|Rey, writing in her survival guide|<ref name="RSG" />}}
[[File:Roodown_and_Rey.png|thumb|right|250px|Roodown informs Rey that Unkar Plutt has been kidnapped by marauders.]]
"Crusher" Roodown was an [[Abednedo]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> [[Gender|male]],<ref name="Force Collection" /> originally from the [[planet]] [[Abednedo (planet)|Abednedo]],<ref name="Geektionary French" /> who for [[Standard year|years]] was one of the best [[scavenger]]s operating out of [[Niima Outpost]] on the planet [[Jakku]], where<ref name="TFAVD" /> he<ref name="Geektionary" /> would bring his junk to [[Merchant|trade]] with the [[junk dealer]] [[Unkar Plutt]], the outpost's proprietor. After Roodown and Plutt had a dispute, Plutt sent his [[Unkar's thugs|thugs]] to cut off the scavenger's [[Limb|arms]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> in the belief that Roodown was selling salvage to another buyer.<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars: The Force Awakens Series 1|cardname="Crusher" Roodown|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/120020/cid/8229589/2015-Topps-Star-Wars-The-Force-Awakens-34-}}</ref>

Roodown had replacement aftermarket [[Labor droid|load-lifter]] arms installed. Unable to salvage again, he was instead allowed to work<ref name="TFAVD" /> for Plutt<ref name="Destroyer Down" /> around Niima, offering his services as a strong back to other scavengers<ref name="TFAVD" /> and completing other small jobs for half portions of [[Foodstuff|food]],<ref name="RSG" /> including occasional work as an enforcer.<ref name="Topps" /> He at one point raised a fist at a passing [[Rey's speeder|speeder]] while hauling material through the desert near one of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] wreckages in Jakku's<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=StarWars|url=StarWars/videos/1030579940326940|name=''[[Star Wars]]''|archivedate=20160219052927}}</ref> [[Starship Graveyard]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

===Interactions with Rey===
{{Quote|Crusher Roodown! Crush that disbelieving sand gnat and toss him out!|Unkar Plutt orders Roodown to deal with Teedo|<ref name="Destroyer Down" />}}
Roodown witnessed the criminal [[Zool Zendiat]] and a group of thugs arrive in Niima and capture Plutt while they searched for the head of a [[J9 worker drone|J9]] [[droid]] that had been sold to the junk dealer. When the [[human]] scavenger [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] arrived in the outpost and asked what had happened, Roodown described Plutt's kidnapping to her shortly before the [[Gabdorin]] [[Krynodd]] declared himself the new "junkboss" of Niima.<ref name="Enemy you Know">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=1|story=Better the Devil You Know, Part I}}</ref> Rey then rescued Plutt, who reclaimed control of Niima.<ref name="Adventures 2">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=2|story=Better the Devil You Know, Part II}}</ref>

[[File:RoodownZuvioTeedo-DestroyerDown.png|thumb|left|300px|Constable Zuvio slices off Roodown's hand.]]
When a storm uncovered the [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Spectral]]'' among the sands of Jakku, Plutt gathered together the scavengers of Niima and announced the appearance of the [[Star Destroyer|ship]], encouraging them to scavenge it for him. The scavenger [[Teedo (Niima Outpost)|Teedo]] was dubious of the [[starship]]'s existence and spoke out against the junk dealer, causing Plutt to order Roodown to crush the naysayer. The Abednedo grabbed Teedo by the throat and lifted him into the air but was prevented from doing any further harm by [[Constable]] [[Zuvio]], who sliced off Roodown's hand with a [[polearm]].<ref name="Destroyer Down" />

Rey was the first to set out for the ''Spectral'', after which Plutt ordered the other scavengers to [[Thief|steal]] whatever she scavenged and bring it to him. The other scavengers then raced off to try and reach the ''Spectral'' while Roodown had his hand reattached by a small droid. During the reattachment, Zuvio threatened Roodown and told him to warn Plutt and his friends that no harm should come to Rey.<ref name="Destroyer Down" />

===Attack on Niima===
Shortly after the [[First Order]] [[Attack on Tuanul|attacked]] the nearby [[Tuanul]] village<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="SWTimelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Roodown was dragging a sled with three non-functional [[I2-CG droid]]s<ref name="TFAVD" /> around Niima when he passed Rey, who had just returned from scavenging in the Starship Graveyard.<ref name="TFA" />

[[File:Roodown_on_Jakku.png|thumb|right|300px|Roodown worked as a strong back in Niima Outpost for Unkar Plutt.]]
Around a [[Standard day|day]] later, Niima was [[Escape from Jakku|attacked]] by the [[First Order military|forces]] of the First Order.<ref name="TFA" /> Rey later wrote about Roodown in a [[Rey's survival guide|survival guide]] she compiled and theorized that he had been allowed to live and work in Niima after losing his arms only because Plutt regretted the incident.<ref name="RSG" />

At some point, Roodown met an [[artist]] who was compiling a [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]] of sketches and stories. The sketch and a description of Roodown were included when the journal was restored, expanded, and displayed by the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archives">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> at some point no earlier than 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Off-worlders led by some guy called Zool Zendiat. They blasted the outpost and grabbed Unkar. Serves 'im right, if you ask me.|Roodown describes Unkar Plutt's kidnapping to Rey|<ref name="Enemy you Know" />}}
Roodown was a large member of the Abednedo [[species]],<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|crusher-roodown|Crusher Roodown}}</ref> with black [[eye]]s and mottled, gray-and-pink skin.<ref name="TFAVD" /> When Unkar Plutt was captured by marauder Zool Zendiat, Roodown believed the junk dealer deserved what had happened to him.<ref name="Enemy you Know" /> Despite this, he was willing to obey Plutt's command to throttle Teedo. When Constable Zuvio told Roodown to spread the word that no harm should come to Rey, the Abednedo questioned why he should be concerned by the possibility.<ref name="Destroyer Down" />

==Equipment==
After losing his real arms to Unkar Plutt's thugs, Roodown's yellow [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] replacement arms granted him greatly enhanced strength.<ref name="Topps" /> He used a sled in Niima that was made out of a scrapped [[water]] tank shell and salvaged [[Engine|thruster]] frame spokes.<ref name="TFAVD" /> Roodown wore green pants with a brown [[belt]], and brown [[Clothing|sandals]] with blue socks.<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Character creation===
{{Quote|I was pretty pleased by the alien being all over the film! Roodown is vastly bigger than the other aliens of the same species. I just thought he'd fallen down on his luck, and now he's got these giant JCB-style arms.|Jake Lunt Davies|<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Roodown_behind_the_scenes.png|thumb|right|300px|Ian Whyte in costume as Roodown on the set of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'']]
Roodown was created for the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], in which he was portrayed by [[Ian Whyte]], who also played the character [[Bollie Prindel]] in the film.<ref name="Celebration">{{SWYouTube|5lknh4bCSCk|Star Wars: The Force Awakens Creature Design Panel | Star Wars Celebration Europe 2016}}</ref> Roodown was created by creature concept designer [[Jake Lunt Davies]],<ref name="Art" /> and his costume was made up of foam and lightweight plastic, with both the suit and mechanical arms attached like a backpack to Whyte's back. The suit was made light and airy due to the extreme heat of the sets in [[Wikipedia:Abu Dhabi|Abu Dhabi]], where Roodown's scenes were filmed.<ref name="Movie Magic">''[[The Moviemaking Magic of Star Wars: Creatures & Aliens]]''</ref> An altered version of Roodown's costume can be seen in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]],<ref name="Andor1">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}</ref> which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}}</ref>

===Naming and other appearances===
Roodown was not identified in the film<ref name="TFA" /> but was first named in ''[[Rey's Survival Guide]]'' by [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="RSG" /> ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' by [[Pablo Hidalgo]],<ref name="TFAVD" /> and ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' by [[Phil Szostak]], reference books released simultaneously in conjunction with the film<ref name="New Books">{{SW|url=news/a-galaxy-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens-books-coming-december-18-first-look|text=A Galaxy of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Books Coming December 18 - UPDATED!}}</ref> on [[December 18]], 2015.<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Like all members of the Abednedo species identified by Hidalgo in the ''Visual Dictionary'', the character was named in reference to the music of the [[Wikipedia:Beastie Boys|Beastie Boys]], as ''The Force Awakens'' director [[J.J. Abrams]] is a fan of the group.<ref name="SWBW 53">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsreport.com/2016/02/19/pablo-hidalgo-interview-swbw-53|text=''Pablo Hidalgo Interview'' – SWBW #53|author=Goins, Aaron|date=2016-02-19|format=[[Wikipedia:Podcast|Podcast]]|work=[http://www.starwarsreport.com The Star Wars Report]|archivedate=20180331234747}}</ref> "Roodown" is likely a reference to the song [[Wikipedia:Root Down (EP)|"Root Down."]]<ref name="Root Down">{{WebCite|url=http://www.discogs.com/master/20196|text=The Beastie Boys* – Root Down|work=[[Wikipedia:Discogs|Discogs]]|archivedate=20160109025935}}</ref>

[[File:Roodown_concept.png|thumb|left|300px|Jake Lunt Davies designed Roodown for ''The Force Awakens''.]]
Prior to the film's release, Roodown made his first appearance in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Immersive 360 Experience]]'', a video created by [[ILM Immersive|ILMxLAB]] as a tie-in to the film and released on [[September 23]], 2015.<ref name="Facebook" /> He also appeared in the Jakku portion of the [[Canon|non-canon]] [[Disneyland]] theme-park attraction ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'',<ref name="Star Tours">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> which opened on [[November 16]], 2015.<ref name="Tours Date">{{DPB|url=2015/11/season-of-the-force-begins-november-16-at-disneyland-park-in-california|text=Season of the Force Begins November 16 at Disneyland Park in California}}</ref> During the segment, Roodown is hauling junk through the wreckage of a Star Destroyer on Jakku when the [[StarSpeeder 1000]] carrying the ride's passengers crashes into the wreckage nearby. Before continuing with his task, Roodown briefly turns his attention to the vehicle, from which several of Unkar Plutt's thugs then begin to scavenge. The StarSpeeder then takes off and leaves the wreckage and Jakku.<ref name="Star Tours" />
